create_writer_csv: create a Writer context manager to log iteration data to a CSV file with a given schema
write_iteration_data: write a row of key-value data to the CSV file for a given iteration index
use_writer_context_manager: use the Writer as a context manager to automatically open and close the CSV file
configure_writer_logging: configure the Writer to optionally log each iteration entry to stdout via abseil logging
customize_writer_iteration_key: customize the Writer iteration column header by setting the iteration_key parameter
